audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Counter Strike 'Dodges autos/Q' (full layer, Key Ability Interactions and the do's line) and the content layer says it 'dodges your autos'. The Q part is false.
audit.why: Riot's Counter Strike text: 'Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming ATTACKS for a short duration and then quickly counterattack.' Attacks, not abilities. Winds of War, the Shield of Durand release and Justice Punch all land through Counter Strike — so the correct play is to keep casting instead of holding everything, which is the opposite of what a reader would take from 'dodges autos/Q'.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike now stated as attack-dodge only, with the note that your spells go through it, in the level-3 spike, the foe-wants line, early, mid and the full layer's interaction and trading blocks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grandmaster-at-Arms is described only as 'R's defensive stats' and the full layer says 'Reassess his ultimate too'.
audit.why: Grandmaster-at-Arms is 110/100/90; the active grants Armor AND Magic Resist, and every third consecutive attack deals bonus MAGIC damage. The MR half is what actually beats a Galio, and the magic third-strike is the one part of his damage your amplified reduction bites hardest — neither was on the page.
audit.corrected: Named at the level-6 phase, the 2+ item spike, the late text and the foe-wants line, with the armour-and-MR detail and the magic third strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Counter Strike' appears throughout with no number, so 'trade on its cooldown' has no size.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9 — 17 seconds at rank 1, against Leap Strike's 8 and Empower's 7. It is by far the longest cooldown in the lane, and it is the only one that makes the window real.
audit.corrected: 17s written into the cooldown block, the do's line, Key Ability Interactions, the trading rules and the loading tip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content says Jax's burst 'still has to commit Leap Strike into your range', implying he can only reach you by committing at you.
audit.why: Riot: 'Jax leaps toward a UNIT.' Any unit — a minion, a ward, a jungle camp. He can close through the wave without ever targeting you and can leave the same way, so the lane read is 'he chooses the timing', not 'he must overcommit'.
audit.corrected: Reworded in whys[1] and the early text so the reader knows Leap Strike works off minions and wards.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads 'EVEN' while diffRating is 8.5/10 and the Final Matchup Rating line says 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: On-disk win rate is 50.19% over 1319 games, which supports EVEN; the 8.5/10 rating and the 'Hard matchup' string do not match the EVEN label and contradict each other on the same page.
audit.corrected: Not changed — 'EVEN' (4 chars) and '8.5/10' (6 chars) cannot be brought into line without a length change outside the band. Flagged for the user.

edits.before: Level 1 you have only Q and no engage, so don't contest Jax's Leap Strike — let him shove and farm him down with the Q tornado from max range. The lane turns at 2-3: your Q poke chips him with damage he can't sustain, and your W becomes a hard answer to his all-in. Watch his E Counter Strike — it dodges your autos and the stun at the end interrupts your W channel, so don't channel W blind. Bait his Leap Strike + Empowered auto first, THEN pop W to halve the committed burst, release the taunt, and Justice Punch him through the lockup.
edits.after: Level 1 you have only Q and no engage, so don't contest Jax — Leap Strike targets any unit, so he can close off a minion whenever he likes. Let him shove and farm him down with the tornado from max range. The lane turns at 2-3: your poke chips damage he cannot sustain, and W becomes a hard answer to his all-in. Counter Strike (17s) dodges basic attacks only, so keep casting through it, but the stun at the end still interrupts a W channel started too early. Bait Leap Strike and Empower first, THEN start W, release the taunt, and punch him through the lockup.

edits.before: This is your lane to own. Jax's all-in routes through Leap Strike and Empowered autos, and your W is the counter — let him jump and dump his combo, channel W to cut the damage (W is heavily amplified vs magic but still eats his physical burst), release the taunt, then E-knockup for a free trade. Just don't start the W channel early, or his E stun cancels it. At 6 Hero's Entrance makes it lethal: drop on him for the taunt-knockup all-in, or flag a fight elsewhere and roam, since your value is map presence, not out-statting him. Punish him hardest while he's single-item.
edits.after: This is your lane to own. Jax's all-in routes through Leap Strike and Empower, and W is the counter — let him jump and dump, channel W to cut the damage, release the taunt, then knock him up for a free trade. Counter Strike only dodges attacks, so Winds of War, the taunt release and Justice Punch all land through it; just don't start the channel early or its stun cancels you. It is 17s at rank 1, the longest cooldown in the lane. At 6 Hero's Entrance makes it lethal: drop on him, or flag a fight elsewhere. Punish him hardest while he is single-item.

edits.before: Be honest about the clock: a 2+ item Jax with Triforce + Blade of the Ruined King and R's defensive stats out-stats you in any extended duel, and your AP/tank damage plateaus while his keeps climbing per stack. Don't side-lane him 1v1 into items. Your late game is your R — global presence, landing the taunt-knockup on his carries in teamfights, and sponging his commitment while your team cleans up. Win the map; never let him isolate you in a long fight.
edits.after: Be honest about the clock: a 2+ item Jax with Triforce and Blade of the Ruined King out-stats you in any extended duel, and Grandmaster-at-Arms hands him armour and MR on top while your damage plateaus. One consolation — his ult's third-strike bonus is magic damage, the one thing your amplified reduction bites hardest. Don't side-lane him 1v1. Your late game is R: global presence, the taunt-knockup on his carries, sponging his commitment while your team cleans up.

notes: Main correction: the page said Counter Strike 'Dodges autos/Q'. Riot's text is 'dodge all incoming ATTACKS' — abilities are unaffected, so Winds of War, the Shield of Durand release and Justice Punch all land through it. The practical advice flips from 'hold everything' to 'keep casting, just don't start the W channel into the stun'. Second: Grandmaster-at-Arms was never named; it grants Armor AND Magic Resist and its every-third-attack bonus is MAGIC damage — the MR is what beats Galio, and the magic third strike is the one part of Jax's damage your amplified reduction is good against. Third: Leap Strike targets any unit, so he does not have to commit at you to close the gap. NOT WRITTEN: champ-data/_kits/jax.json carries a derived 'dash' flag on Empower (W), and _missing-interactions.json builds 'Your Justice Punch shuts off Jax's Leap Strike (Q), Empower (W)' from it. Empower is a next-attack buff with no movement in Riot's description, so the W half of that headline is a tooltip-parse misfire and I left it off the page. RATING INCONSISTENCY for the user: diff is 'EVEN' but diffRating is 8.5/10 and the Final Matchup Rating line says 'Hard matchup' — three different verdicts on one page. On-disk win rate is 50.19% over 1319 games.
